suggestions.title: Saving Private Ryan
suggestions.description: A group of U.S. soldiers search behind enemy lines for a paratrooper whose three brothers have been killed in action. Steven Spielberg's visceral WWII epic redefined war cinema with its gut-wrenching Omaha Beach opening sequence — raw, unflinching, and profoundly human. Tom Hanks delivers a career-defining performance as Captain Miller, leading a squad through impossible moral choices in the fog of war.

suggestions.title: The Lion King
suggestions.description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's murder and must find the courage to reclaim his throne. Disney's Renaissance masterpiece — stunning hand-drawn animation, Hans Zimmer's legendary score, Elton John's timeless songs, and a Shakespearean story that hits adults as hard as kids. Hakuna Matata meets Hamlet in a circle-of-life epic that has never aged a day.

suggestions.title: Oldboy
suggestions.description: A man is imprisoned in a hotel room for fifteen years, then released and given five days to find his captor. Park Chan-wook's brutal masterpiece of revenge cinema — the legendary one-take hallway fight scene alone is worth the price of admission. A Korean neo-noir that twists and turns until its devastating finale. Not for the faint of heart, but absolutely unforgettable.
